profileLabel: Mixed-to-slight-left economics (low confidence); mildly restrictive online speech; democratic institutions slightly positive
summary: Leyte 3rd District representative with 84 principal-authored bills. Authored a Revised Labor Code, wider employment anti-discrimination for women, violence-against-women definition, an anti-dynasty ban, right-to-information, raised campaign expense limits, changed candidate-substitution grounds, a constitutional convention call, a false-information ban and online child sexual abuse safeguards. Co-authored P200 wage increase and rice tariff revenue for palay procurement.
caveat: Constitutional convention (HB05870) scope is unspecified and scored 0. Labor Code content not reviewed. Gender bills are one issue, so social values is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Labor: Revised Labor Code (0) and co-authored P200 wage increase (-2) net -1; co-authored rice tariff revenue for palay procurement (-2). Two issues, partly co-authored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04618; co-author HB00766, HB00048 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored a ban on deliberate dissemination of false information (-2) and online child sexual abuse safeguards (-1). Two issues, titles only; safety rationale exists.

democratic.rationale: Authored right-to-information (+3) and an anti-dynasty ban (+3), offset by raised campaign expense limits and changed candidate-substitution grounds (-2). Constitutional convention call scored 0 (scope unspecified). Four issues, bill-based.
